description.value: Permanent immunity to disease and resistance to poison; once per day, treat a failed Fortitude save as a success instead.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Once per day, treat a failed Fortitude save as a success instead' has no rule-element hook -- There is no rule-element that guarantees an outright success or converts a failed save/check to a success after the fact; AdjustDegreeOfSuccess only shifts the degree of an actual roll. The disease immunity and poison resistance are built above.
